intro.text: An ancient Veden scholar, also called Oileyes, who wrote a dramatised account of King NanKhet's life and death.

items.text: Natata lived in Jah Keved two hundred years after NanKhet's death, and her account of him is the earliest source on him to survive. She insisted her research was rigorous, though Jasnah Kholin notes scholarship was still young then, and she took delight in the irony of NanKhet's last moments.
